method.dependencies: Three standalone native PEs; no fetched dependency or PURL.

samples.marker: Salat stealer/RAT: restore dump detection; correct token traits
evidence: Recovered PE32 memory dump: populated UPX0, .CAPE reconstruction section, usable Go pclntab with 10636 functions. UPX rejects it because the code is already unpacked.

main.getChromeLogins at 0x1182e70 opens the database with database/sql.Open (0x1182fc9). QueryContext at 0x118303e uses SELECT origin_url, action_url, username_value, password_value, date_created FROM logins. Rows.Scan at 0x1183263 feeds password material to main.DecryptChrome at 0x1183329; plaintext fields are formatted at 0x1183478.

main.GetChromiumMasterKeys at 0x1188140 calls DPAPI. Separate paths handle Chromium app-bound keys, SYSTEM impersonation and Firefox NSS stores. These are concrete credential recovery paths, not conclusions from routine names.

main.runKeylogger opens a file with append/create flags at 0x1161ee1; constructs a WH_KEYBOARD_LL=13 argument vector at 0x1162055 and installs the callback via windows.LazyProc.Call at 0x116208d. keyPressCallback tests WM_KEYDOWN/WM_SYSKEYDOWN at 0x1161832..0x1161840 and writes recorded text through bufio.Writer.WriteString at 0x116191c and later branches.

main.Steal calls browser collectors and archive/zip.CreateHeader repeatedly. It closes the archive at 0x117878b, Base64-encodes that same buffer at 0x1178851, serializes the record with json.Marshal at 0x1178ab4, transforms it through main.dec and submits it via main.rq at 0x1178b90. main.rq retries main.tryRQ and changes endpoints on failures.

WebSocket ReadMessage at 0x1149670 supplies remote message handling in main.(*wsSess).recvWss; command branches reach os/exec.Command. main.(*wsSess).execCommand invokes Command at 0x115779f and Run at 0x11577e4. This is a remotely tasked credential-stealing RAT.

main.dec implements multiple data transforms including AES NewCipher/NewGCM and recursive modes. Long fused Go string constants survive in the dump, but the text extractor omits the credential SELECT; a section-scoped hex fallback is required.
The outer PE contains a PE32 DLL at file offset 0x5060, with image base 0x10000000, .data code and live Winsock imports. Randomized descriptive strings do not obscure its control flow.

Receive at 0x10006b45 fills the record buffer; the positive-length guard is followed by a copy at 0x10006b69 and dispatch on the first dword. Task fields supply target and attack parameters to flood handlers.

Raw UDP worker 0x1000228e calls WSASocketA(AF_INET=2, SOCK_RAW=3, IPPROTO_UDP=17) at 0x100022b6. It resolves the configured target, builds sockaddr data, then repeatedly performs twelve sendto calls at 0x1000236b followed by Sleep and a jump back to the stop check at 0x1000234a.

These are packet-tasked network-exhaustion capabilities. Storm server version/DLL identity corroborates the family; Elex, Remcos and WannaCry in the collector filename do not identify this program. Existing hostile flood and StormAttack traits are supported.

UPX 5.2.1 decompresses the native MinGW PE. Product/version/author resources name Eupdate Helper 4.0.1.0, consistent with ESET update-manifest paths, ecmd.exe /update invocation, singleton mutex and local proxy behavior.

Self-update at 0x412964 fetches version/downurl metadata. MessageBoxW at 0x412c6e asks for user confirmation, and cmp eax,6 / jne 0x412f54 at 0x412c77..0x412c7a gates replacement. Accepted updates are downloaded, checked for MZ, swapped and launched.

0x416bb0 decodes each byte as input[i] XOR key XOR ((31*i+7)&255). Four callers decode constants at 0x421e0c/0x421e14/0x421e04/0x421df8 to encrypt, type, /id.html and id.1yz.me. This is upstream account-list retrieval, not local credential collection.

The listener uses port 8000. On bind failure, GetExtendedTcpTable selects the process owning that port before OpenProcess/TerminateProcess; there is no defender kill list. HKLM Run registration and ShellExecuteW runas use ordinary autostart and UAC mechanisms.

The proxy relays ESET updates, refuses .signed paths with 404, filters SERVERS/LINKS/HOSTS metadata and relaxes WinHTTP certificate checks. These are notable capabilities and weak trust choices; no malicious update substitution, covert access surface, spying or theft was established.

0x4127e4 opens its image, seeks to EOF and appends 4..11 pseudorandom bytes. The standby handoff and scheduled hash rotation are real; retain the single suspicious self-hash-rotation-relaunch trait. No concrete hostile behavior supports the ensemble conviction.

changes.hook_recovery: Move the hook-ID argument vector and composite to hardware/input/keyboard/hook, and keyboard-down branching to hardware/input/event; retain .text signatures and add UPX0 variants. Update the recording consumer. ToUnicodeEx uses a substring because Go constants are concatenated without word boundaries.
changes.credential_evidence: Move the Go browser credential rule from generic theft/multi-app to browser/chromium, rename it go-browser-login-query-with-keylogging, and require a credential-column SELECT reference. Add a UPX0 byte fallback for the text-extractor miss. Update Salat identity to reference the new rule.
changes.managed_tokens: Retire ambiguous Send/Receive-only socket observations. Move Kill, Append and CreateInstance name references to metadata/binary/symbols/name and require a CLR runtime header. Update all exact consumers; compiled-only StringBuilder and VB.NET token composites drop impossible CSharp source alternatives. This intentionally narrows matching to supported metadata evidence.
changes.word_runs: Move punctuation-prefixed common-word runs out of anti-static objectives into a whole-file string-population observation. Preserve the matcher and count, and update the junk-padding consumer; the measurement alone no longer implies junk insertion.
changes.third_party: Suppress the overlapping Elastic generic threat label only when native Salat behavioral identity fires; preserve generic coverage elsewhere. CAPE and Elastic Salat-specific labels remain.

validation: Final make validate result is reported in the response; no precompile is needed because no inline YARA source changed.
